plain_language: The Income Tax Department compared your return for Assessment Year {assessment_year} with the information that {income_source} reported to it. The Department's records show {amount} that does not appear in your return, so it has proposed adding this amount to your income and recomputing the tax.
what_this_does_not_mean: This does not automatically mean you owe tax on {amount} — it means the Department's records and your return don't match, and you are being asked to explain the difference.
possible_reasons: The income was received but was not included in your return
The income was already included in your return under a different head
The same income was reported twice by the payer
The information belongs to someone else's account (for example, a family member's)
The payer reported the amount incorrectly
